headline: Samsung and SK Hynix Release Tens of Trillions Won; Why Did Their Stock Prices Diverge? [Stock Novice]
summary: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix released large shareholder return packages, yet their share price reactions differed widely. The article describes a broader market trend of companies returning earnings to shareholders.
why: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are the two largest pillars of South Korea's semiconductor industry, and their capital returns affect investor demand.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: Large shareholder return programs were announced, but the stock reaction differed from SK Hynix's.
